observations: Contrôle image-prompt relu sur le candidat exact automatiser-l-entree-en-relation-d-un-nouveau-client.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Memlia accounting blog cover, horizontal 16:9, safe for a centered 1200x630 crop. Premium isometric 3D editorial diorama with simplified geometric objects, matte ceramic and thick blank paper, soft studio light from upper left, short shadows, warm cream paper background #fcfbf7, Memlia green #27b657, deep green #1c8a41 and graphite #231f20. Substantial clear objects readable at thumbnail size, airy coherent composition, consistent with the existing Memlia matte 3D blog covers. No photographic desk scene, no people, no hands, no faces, no human figure, no pawn, no vegetation or scenery, no letters, no readable text, no numbers, no amount, no percentage, no logo, no watermark, no screen, no dashboard, no software interface, no red alert, no automatic sending symbol, no approval seal, no legal or financial certification. No other saturated color. One original wide illustration, no caption. Subject: Preparing a new client onboarding dossier with a missing document still awaiting examination. An open plain green paper folder, three shallow green geometric document trays, two holding blank cream cards and one visibly empty. A separate graphite review tray contains one blank cream card placed loosely, still unfiled. No ID card, portrait, identity pictogram or personal information. Preparation and incomplete dossier, no approval.

brief.sujet: Préparation du dossier d’entrée en relation : pièces reçues et pièce encore attendue, examen distinct.
brief.composition: Dossier vert ouvert, trois plateaux verts dont un vide et plateau graphite distinct avec une feuille non classée ; composition isométrique aérée.
brief.style: Diorama 3D isométrique, formes géométriques simplifiées, matières mates, lumière douce du haut gauche, ombres courtes, fond crème.
brief.palette: Crème #fcfbf7 dominante, accents vert #27b657 et vert profond #1c8a41, touches graphite #231f20 ; parts observées, non conformité revendiquée.
brief.interdits: Texte, lettres, chiffres, logo, personnage, main, donnée client, fausse interface, alerte rouge, symbole d’envoi automatique ou certification.
brief.alt: Dossier ouvert et plateaux de pièces, dont un vide, avec une feuille dans un plateau d’examen distinct.
